name: Magnet CTF 2021 iOS — Eli Flatt iPhone 8 Evasion Pattern
description: GrayKey extraction of iPhone 8 (iOS 14.4) belonging to Eli Flatt. Triple encrypted comms stack (Wickr+Psiphon, Signal, ProtonMail) with active recruitment to Wickr, minimal digital footprint, prepaid carrier. SUSPICION verdict — coherent evasion pattern but each artifact individually explainable.
source: Magnet Virtual Summit 2021 CTF — iOS Challenge

artifacts.description: WickrEnterprise (com.mywickr.wickr) with embedded PsiphonTunnel.framework for censorship circumvention VPN. WickrID: eflatt610.
Signal v5.4.0 (org.whispersystems.signal) registered 2021-02-16 via SMS code 191-116. Database exists (signal.sqlite, SQLCipher encrypted).
ProtonMail (ch.protonmail.protonmail) with iCloud sync enabled. Persistent queue directories present.

SMS sent from device recruiting contact +15713106012 to join Wickr: 'Hey! Join me on Wickr for the most secure communications experience - for FREE! Getting started is easy >> https://me-download.wickr.com. My WickrID is eflatt610'. First Wickr message follows 27h later.

5 encrypted Wickr messages with auto-destruct between 2021-03-04 and 2021-03-07. All ZBODY fields are encrypted blobs. Message 3 is type 7 (media/call). Content irrecoverable without Wickr session keys.
Total Wireless prepaid carrier. No contract. Reduced traceability compared to postpaid carriers.
AddressBook contains only 1 contact (Apple Inc / 1-800-MY-APPLE). All personal contacts exist only in ephemeral SMS/iMessage cache.
routined/Local.sqlite completely empty (0 visits, 0 learned locations, 0 WiFi APs). Only 1 geofence in consolidated.db: Burlington, VT (44.4737N, -73.2134W).
Passcode 185185 — 6-digit numeric, repeating pattern, Shannon entropy 1.585 bits. Inconsistent with privacy-focused app selection.

findings.title: Stack de comunicaciones cifradas multicapa con evasion VPN
findings.devil_advocate: Wickr Me era popular entre usuarios privacy-conscious. Psiphon puede indicar acceso desde red restrictiva. Millones usan apps cifradas sin intencion maliciosa.

findings.title: Reclutamiento activo de contacto a Wickr via SMS
findings.devil_advocate: SMS es template auto-generado de Wickr via funcion 'invite friend'. Muchos usuarios envian invitaciones sin implicaciones operativas.

findings.title: Huella digital minima en dispositivo
findings.devil_advocate: Dispositivo nuevo o secundario. Location Services desactivado por preferencia. Contactos no sincronizados desde iCloud.

findings.title: Passcode debil inconsistente con perfil de privacidad
findings.devil_advocate: Passcodes debiles son extremadamente comunes. Privacidad de comunicaciones y seguridad de acceso fisico son preocupaciones independientes.

findings.title: Geolocalizacion en Burlington, VT
findings.devil_advocate: Area code 585 no vincula a ubicacion fisica en celulares prepago. Burlington es una ciudad universitaria.

findings.title: Perfil de uso dual: apps cifradas + redes sociales
findings.devil_advocate: Uso dual indica privacidad selectiva, no evasion sistematica. Actor que busca evasion total no tendria Facebook con identidad real.
